metadata.title: On-Premises Deployment — Ground Plex on RedHat OpenShift
metadata.author: SnapLogic Solutions Engineering

content.title: On-Premises Deployment — Ground Plex on RedHat OpenShift
content.content:
SnapLogic's execution engine — the **Ground Plex** — is deployed as containerised workloads within {{customer_name}}'s private data center, running on RedHat OpenShift. All pipeline execution, data transformation, and connector activity occurs entirely within {{customer_name}}'s network boundary. No customer data is transmitted to or processed by SnapLogic's cloud infrastructure at any point in the integration lifecycle.

The SnapLogic Manager (cloud-hosted) handles only non-data metadata: pipeline definitions (stored as JSON), schedules, user accounts, and audit logs. It communicates with the Ground Plex over a single outbound HTTPS connection (port 443), requiring no inbound firewall exceptions on the {{customer_name}} perimeter. The Manager qualifies under the RFP's stated exception for non-data components, subject to formal {{customer_name}} Security approval — which SnapLogic supports with detailed network architecture documentation, data flow diagrams, and a dedicated security review process.
